main_text.head: INFAMIA, nota turpitudinis 2. Cor.6.8. Vide FAMA.
main_text.p: INFANTES, in vrbium expugnatione reseruandi, Deut.20. 14. Christo oblati, Matth.19.13. (vide & Marc.10.13.14. Luc.18.15. Infantibus similes nos esse oportet, Matt.19.14. & 18.3. sicut infantes modò geniti simus, 1.Pet.2.2. Ab Herode occisi: Matt.2.16.

INFANTIA quæ laudanda, Matth.18.v.3.4. Luc.18.16.1.Cor. 14.20. Eph.4.14.1.Petr.2.2. Infantia spiritualis, 1.Cor.3.1. Vbi infantiam opponit paulus adultæ ætati, ideoque lactis nomine prima Christianæ religionis tyrocinia significat. Petrus verò, 1.Pet.2.2. infantiam priori illi corruptissimæ vitæ opponit, & perpetuum lactis (i.veræ & synceræ doctrinæ Euangelicæ) vsum commendat: vnde patet, infantiæ nomen diuerso respectu & sensu tam à Paulo, quàm à Petro, vsurpari.
INFATVARI, est omni acrimonia deperdita, qua res à putredine arcentur, insipidum euadere, Matth.5.13. vbi Apostoli sal terræ appellantur.
INFERIORES: Inferiorum consilia non sunt contemnenda. Exempla: Vxoris Naaman pedissequa, 2. Regum 5 3. Serui Naaman, verf. 13. Abigail, 1. Sam.25.25. Ioab, 1.Par. 21.3.

INFERI, vel INFERNVS, pro sepulchro, Genes.42.38. & 44. 29.Iob.14.13. & 17.13. Psal.6.6. & 16.10. & 18.6. & 30.4. & 49. 15. & 94.17. & 115.17. & 141.9. Esai.38.18. Ezech.31.16. Act.2. 31. & 13.35. Inferi vel infernus, pro loco, eóque horribili, puniendis reprobis destinato, Num.16.v.30.33. Deut.32. 22. Prou.2.18. & 7.27. Psal.(11.6. & 21.11. & 40.15.) & 55.16. & 139.8. Esai.14.9. & 28.v.15.18. Esa.30.33. & 33.11. & 34.9. Amos 9.2. Abac.2.5. Matt.8.12. & 11.23. & 16.18. Luc.10.15. Apoc. 1.18. & 6.8. & 20.v.13.14. Poena in eo nunquam terminanda, Esai.66.24. Matth.25.v.41.46. Marc.9.47.48. 2.Thess. 1.9. (Vide DESCENDERE ad inferos.) Quare falsa est.
